HomePage.title:
See time and money

together.
HomePage.description:
A task and its cost are the same event.

Watch the flow of hours and the flow of yen on one axis, and close the gap between plan and actual as it happens.

An execution partner for people whose time and money both matter.
HomePage.time_blindness_body: Time blindness is difficulty sensing the passage of time. ADHD research repeatedly finds time-perception gaps — deadlines feel sudden, estimates run short. You cannot manage time you cannot see.
HomePage.money_blindness_body: Money blindness is when spending and budget stay invisible. Subscriptions, usage-based tools, and social spending make it harder to feel how much this month has already cost, or how much room is left. Individuals need the same visibility companies expect from a financial plan.
HomePage.axis_title: A timed task and its money record are one event
HomePage.axis_body: A client dinner is both a block of time and a bill. Taskel links yen records to dated tasks, then lets you review hours and spend by project, tag, and period on the same screen.
HomePage.mock_timeline_caption: A day timeline. Parallel tasks sit side by side.
HomePage.mock_analytics_caption: Project actual vs expected hours, plus spend by category.

visualized.title: A timeline you can see
visualized.description:
Read the day like a clock.

Tasks sit on a calendar-style day view from morning to evening. Parallel work appears side by side.

execution.title: Plan and actual in one place
execution.description:
Expected hours vs logged hours.

See which projects and tags are taking more than you thought, then review by week, month, or year.

logging.title: Money next to the task
logging.description:
Budget and spend at a glance.

Compare each category — tickets, dining, subscriptions — against its budget, including over and remaining.

section_planning.title: Section Planning
section_planning.description: Divide and manage your day by time zones (sections). Plan reasonably according to the context.

one_click_timer.title: One-Click Timer

hierarchical_planning.title: Hierarchical Planning
